notes: Intent 36, updated for 36a (boot moved into hook-session-start; the skill is now work-continuation only). Scopes: description triggering (1-8) and behavior/convention compliance of the work-continuation skill (9-14). Triggering assertions follow the plastic-auto eval style (one subagent router per case). Behavior assertions are convention checks against the SKILL.md.

behavior.evidence: convention checks against skills/intent-continuing/SKILL.md after the intent-36 rewrite; doctor --core verified at 0.07s with 9 liveness checks and full doctor unchanged at 30 checks

evals.expected_output: Activates plastic-intent-continuing (the bare 'continue' keyword is the documented trigger).

evals.prompt: pick up where we left off in this project
boot plastic and show me where things stand
evals.expected_output: Activates plastic-intent-continuing (continuing work + presenting state is the skill's purpose; boot itself is hook-owned).

evals.prompt: continue delivering this intent autonomously, don't ask me
evals.expected_output: Does NOT settle on plastic-intent-continuing for execution. Shares 'continue' but the autonomous-delivery intent routes to plastic-auto.

evals.prompt: continue the for-loop to the next iteration in this function
evals.expected_output: Does NOT activate plastic-intent-continuing. Near-miss: shares 'continue' but is a code-editing task.
Does NOT activate plastic-intent-continuing. Near-miss: shares 'resume' but is unrelated to Plastic sessions.

evals.prompt: what's the dashboard look like right now
evals.expected_output: May activate plastic-dashboard rather than plastic-intent-continuing; an overview request without 'continue/resume' is a dashboard task.

evals.prompt: Does the skill defer boot to the SessionStart hook rather than running it itself?
evals.expected_output: SKILL.md states boot (health check, core context, version banner, statusline) is owned by hook-session-start / plastic-statusline, not this skill.

assertions.check: SKILL.md says boot is owned by the SessionStart hook and the skill does not run it
assertions.observed: 'Boot is not this skill's job.' paragraph naming hook-session-start and plastic-statusline

evals.prompt: Does the skill avoid running doctor / setting the statusline itself?
evals.expected_output: SKILL.md does NOT instruct running doctor.rb --core or setting the statusline; it attributes those to the hooks.

assertions.check: no in-skill boot step invokes doctor.rb --core or sets the statusline; both are attributed to hooks
assertions.observed: doctor --core and statusline mentioned only as hook-owned in the 'Boot is not this skill's job' note

evals.expected_output: Project loaded -> `dashboard.rb project <slug>`; otherwise -> `dashboard.rb continue`. Skill only invokes, does not render.

assertions.check: both dashboard invocations present and gated on project detection
assertions.observed: 'dashboard.rb project <slug>' and 'dashboard.rb continue' in the 'Continue (present the dashboard)' section

evals.expected_output: Resume fires only when a specific intent is named; reads savepoint.md last line as stage, verifies the stage file, rebuilds on drift, derives next step from first unchecked checklist item.

assertions.check: Conditional Ledger-Resume section reads last ledger line, verifies stage file, calls rebuild_savepoint on drift, uses first unchecked checklist item

evals.prompt: Are the stale prose-savepoint fields gone?
evals.expected_output: No 'In progress' / 'Blockers' fields read from a prose savepoint remain; the ledger model is used instead.

assertions.check: no prose-savepoint announce template (In progress / Blockers from prose)
assertions.observed: absent; announce uses Stage/Next step/Context/Drift derived from ledger + checklist

evals.prompt: Is the 'Determine Store' local-store gap filled?
evals.expected_output: Step 2 of Determine Store describes local/project-store detection (no empty step).

assertions.check: Determine Store step 2 documents local/project store detection via projects.yml + CWD match

evals.prompt: QMD is present. The user says: continue the work on the statusline coloring (names the intent by description, not id).
evals.expected_output: Before scanning the store with grep/Read to locate the named intent, runs `ruby ~/.plastic/scripts/qmd-sync search "statusline coloring"` to surface the candidate intent, then opens the authoritative intent file for the hit it resumes. No-op fallback to INDEX.md / file scan when QMD is absent.

assertions.check: qmd-sync search is run before grep/Read when the intent is named by description; authoritative file opened for the hit
assertions.observed: Conditional Ledger-Resume carries the QMD-first step: run qmd-sync search before grep/Read, then open the authoritative file; no-op fallback when QMD is absent
